explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the Father of the disciples and the source of all blessings, called "the God of all spirits" in the chapter.
The quality of enduring suffering or difficulties with patient strength without losing faith in God's plan.
God's disciplining of His children for their own blessing and sanctification, compared to a father's upbringing of his son.
People who are chosen and dedicated to God, called "the holy ones" or those who participate in God's holy community.
The great gathering on Zion where all believers assemble to meet the Lord, described as a grand feast with thousands of angels.
The concept that sins and obstacles are completely removed so that one can run the race without hindrance.
The deep rest and harmony between God and humanity achieved through God's grace, in contrast to war or conflict.
The concept of the Christian journey where believers are to move forward with perseverance toward the goal set by Jesus.
